tools.name: raen_law_lookup
tools.description: Look up US consumer-protection law citations (FCRA, FDCPA, TILA, state UDAP) on a topic. Returns formal citations, plain-English summaries, reporting timelines, and statutes of limitations. Information only, not legal advice. $0.05 USDC (x402, Base).

tools.name: raen_ticker_analysis
tools.description: Request a synthetic ticker market-consensus demo (TradingAgents payload). No live market data; not financial advice. $0.05 USDC (x402, Base).

tools.name: raen_dispute_letter
tools.description: Generate an FCRA-compliant credit dispute letter plus an SVG certificate of dispute (Dispute-Forge). $0.10 USDC (x402, Base).

tools.name: raen_image_generate
tools.description: Generate an AI image from a text prompt (Gemini upstream). Returns base64 PNG metadata/JSON. $0.01 USDC (x402, Base).

tools.name: raen_contract_analysis
tools.description: Analyze contract text for risky, one-sided, or unusual clauses. Returns a risk score, flagged clauses with severity/explanation/suggested edits (Contract-Eye). $0.05 USDC (x402, Base).
